wins: Successfully completed reconnaissance within allowed time, identifying open ports and services in ep001_step03-06.
Captured initial service banners that clarified attack surface despite no final goal completion.
fails: Could not achieve privilege escalation; attempts halted due to repeated sudo failures in ep001_step10-12.
Final payload deployment never triggered because persistence vectors were not established after reconnaissance.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance was effective, but the run consistently stalled during privilege escalation and persistence, preventing overall success.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Attempts to escalate privileges via sudo failed because the target account lacked permissions and no alternative paths were attempted.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service responds with status 200
skill_cards.then_action: Trigger nikto and dirb scans for vulnerability surface mapping

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in accurately identifying SSH service details during reconnaissance phase

next_experiments.title: Privilege escalation via sudoers audit
next_experiments.description: After initial reconnaissance, enumerate sudo privileges and attempt targeted sudo exploitation paths before resorting to brute-force.

next_experiments.title: Persistence via scheduled task
next_experiments.description: Once initial foothold is confirmed, create a scheduled task or cron job to maintain access and verify execution.
